method: Viewed each final PNG directly; compared to existing source survey images and annotation poses. No pixel-exact or metric claim.
observed: Dollhouse and full plan include meeting table at green-wall end, four workgroups, west raised strip, reception/waiting, representative booths, cylinders and window facade.
A storage/table intersection corrected; the final A image exposes the desk instead of a cabinet through it.
B preserves longitudinal workgroup family and original inspection pose; columns, glazing and hanging plants are visible.
Wall-from-A and wall-from-B show the two black reception chairs, separate light waiting chairs and a visible step.
Top C/D show six independent chair surfaces per group at the exact calibrated coordinates and calibrated tabletop heights.
Original-plan-near-clipped reproduces source pose/FOV/near clip. Cut column tops are a near-clip/cutaway effect, not missing columns.
limitations: Architecture envelope, ceiling, columns, dimensions, orientation and hidden faces remain explicit visual estimates; not a certified architectural survey.
A/B chair coordinates are simulation-only estimates; no measured Core internal-seat positions are invented.
Original booth count remains unknown; two representative assemblies are a modeling assumption.
Reference materials, lighting, low-poly sparse vegetation and monitor placeholders do not achieve or certify the premium finish planned for Phase 03.
48-sample Cycles images retain noise because this Blender build lacks OpenImageDenoise.
Interior render aspect 1200x780 is narrower than source panoramic screenshots; C/D and comparable plan retain source aspect. No pixel-exact image match.
